summary: AST SpaceMobile filed an 8-K to disclose a satellite launch incident, not a special situation. The Block 2 BlueBird 7 satellite was deployed into a lower-than-planned orbit by New Glenn's upper stage and will be de-orbited; the cost is expected to be recovered via insurance. The company is in production of satellites through BlueBird 32, with BlueBird 8-10 ready to ship in ~30 days, and targets ~45 satellites in orbit by end of 2026 with launches every 1-2 months. This operational update carries no deal structure, financial terms, or board recommendation and is a routine current report on a business event.
